registrations.presentation: (see reverse for formulation) Emulsion for IV Infusion

summary: Vitalipid N Adult (Fresenius Kabi AB) is an emulsion of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D2, E and K1) added to a lipid emulsion in parenteral nutrition, one 10 ml ampoule per day for adults. Philippine registration: 10 ml glass ampoules.
composition_notes: Source is the Irish SmPC of the same Fresenius Kabi product sold in Ireland as Vitlipid N Adult; confirm against the Philippine package insert.
dosing_limits: Adults and children 11 years and older: one ampoule (10 ml) per day, added to a lipid emulsion (SmPC 4.2).
kidney_notes: The SmPC sections on warnings and interactions do not mention renal impairment.
Vitamin K1 may interact with coumarin-type anticoagulants (SmPC 4.5).
Prolonged overdose can raise vitamin D metabolite levels (SmPC 4.9).
guideline_heading: How it fits the ESPEN 2021 kidney nutrition guideline
bottom_line: The standard fat-soluble vitamin additive; the SmPC gives no kidney-specific warning. ESPEN 2021 recommendations quoted here do not address fat-soluble vitamins specifically, so dose per the SmPC and check INR when a patient is on warfarin.
